items.exampleEn: How would you like your steak?
We bought some snacks for the trip.
items.exampleZh: 我們買了一些零食路上吃。

items.exampleEn: Can you pass me the jam?
A barbecue in the park is a lot of fun.
This restaurant is famous for its seafood.
The cafeteria on the first floor is cheap.
items.exampleZh: 一樓的自助餐廳很便宜。
items.glossZh: 自助餐廳；員工或學生餐廳

items.exampleEn: I'd like a burger and fries, please.
Our cooler keeps food cold all day.
items.exampleZh: 我們的保冷箱能讓食物冰一整天。

items.sentenceEn: Let's bring a cooler to the beach.
items.sentenceZh: 我們帶個保冷箱去海邊吧。

items.audioEn: At the barbecue, we had steak, sausages and fresh seafood.
items.audioZh: 烤肉的時候，我們吃了牛排、香腸和新鮮海鮮。

items.sentenceEn: I always eat a snack after school.
items.sentenceZh: 我放學後總是會吃點心。

items.stemEn: Do you want some ____ on your toast?
items.stemZh: 你的吐司要不要塗一點果醬？

items.stemEn: Many students eat lunch in the school ____.
items.stemZh: 很多學生在學校的自助餐廳吃午餐。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, Ben's family had a barbecue by the sea. They brought a big cooler full of cold drinks. Ben's father cooked steak, and his uncle brought fresh seafood from the market. Ben's little sister only wanted fries! In the afternoon, they had bread with jam as a snack.
items.passageZh: 上週六，Ben 一家人在海邊烤肉。他們帶了一個裝滿冰飲料的大保冷箱。Ben 的爸爸烤牛排，叔叔從市場帶來新鮮的海鮮。Ben 的妹妹只想吃薯條！下午，他們吃麵包配果醬當點心。

referenceEn: The seafood at this shop is very fresh.
This shop's seafood is very fresh.
rubricZh: 「海鮮」用 seafood（不可數，不加 s）
主詞是 seafood 時 be 動詞用 is

items.instructionZh: 用 snack 造一個句子，說說你喜歡的點心，或你什麼時候吃點心。
referenceEn: I eat a snack when I feel hungry.
rubricZh: snack 是可數名詞（例如 a snack、my favorite snack）
時態配合句意（例如 is、eat）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：疑似詞義不符：wordCard 字是 fry，但例句只用名詞 fries、釋義「薯條」；CEFR-J A2 的 fry 主要是動詞「（油）炸、煎」。依已裁原則應示範動詞（例如 Fry the eggs in a little oil.）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 不改：lexicon 的 fry 是名詞 A2、動詞 B1（第③關也確認 fry 名詞＝A2）；依「照該級詞性教」維持名詞「薯條」，不示範 B1 的動詞義
